name: Super Easy Stroganoff
notes: I—Marta—love this recipe because it’s quick and easy and I have almost all the ingredients on hand already. The texture and taste come out just the way I like them too!

items: 2 cups rice, or a bag of egg noodles
1 medium onion (you may also use some finely diced apple)

steps.title: Cook the rice or noodles
steps.body: Cook **2 cups rice**, or **a bag of egg noodles**, in a separate pan.

steps.title: Cook the beef
steps.body: Cook **1 lb ground beef** and **1 medium onion** (you may also use some finely diced apple) over the stove in a large pan or pot.

steps.title: Add the soup and milk
steps.body: Add **1 can cream of mushroom soup** and **1½ cups milk**. Allow it to simmer and thicken.

steps.title: Take off heat
steps.body: Take off heat when you’ve reached the desired consistency.

steps.title: Add the sour cream
steps.body: Add **1 cup sour cream** and then season to taste.
